title: Washing day
subtitle: Swipe down to slide. Bounce on the cot.

sections.name: WashingDay
sections.note: Washing day: sarees drying in the yards, the rooster ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstNeem
sections.note: A neem by the road, its low limb across the street: swipe down and slide under; the low mangoes show the way.

sections.name: HandPump
sections.note: The hand pump: women wash the clothes there and the water spreads across the road. Hold the jump.

sections.name: NeemHens
sections.note: Another neem, then two hens pecking in the road: slide, then jump.

sections.name: FirstCot
sections.note: A rope cot carried out into the sun: run into it and bounce; a feather above its top for a double jump.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: A breather: a wave of mangoes and the first chilli.

sections.name: NeemGoat
sections.note: A neem's low branch, then a goat kid wandering across.

sections.name: Sacks
sections.note: Sacks of paddy waiting for the cart: hop onto them and run off the end; a feather above them.

sections.name: CotNeem
sections.note: The cot, then a neem: bounce, land, slide.

sections.name: DogDung
sections.note: The dog asleep in the dust, then cow dung.

sections.name: HensPump
sections.note: Two hens, then the second hand pump's puddle.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A chilli and a long straight.

sections.name: CotSand
sections.note: A house going up: the cot, then a heap of building sand after the landing.

sections.name: NeemDung
sections.note: A neem, then dung: slide, then tap. A feather above the dung for a double jump.

sections.name: GoatHen
sections.note: A goat kid, then a hen.

sections.name: Mischief
sections.note: The third pump's puddle; then the rooster knocks the water pots off their stand by the pump into the road.

sections.name: CotDogCot
sections.note: Two cots out in the sun with the dog asleep between them: bounce, jump, bounce.

sections.name: ChilliLane
sections.note: A breather and a chilli.

sections.name: NeemGoatDog
sections.note: A neem, a goat kid, the dog.

sections.name: LastSacks
sections.note: The last sacks, then two hens.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: The last chilli.

sections.name: LastTest
sections.note: The last pump's puddle, a cot, a neem, dung: everything once more.

sections.name: OpenLane
sections.note: The lane opens out: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 290 m.
